description: Goes through the 16 controls of the SEAL Security Frameworks certification for DNS & Registrar and marks what public data shows for each: ok, partial, gap, not visible from outside, or a process control the team has to document itself. Includes DNSSEC, CAA, SPF/DMARC/MTA-STS, locks, expiry and security.txt.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. app.example.com. A URL is accepted too; only the host is used.

name: check_seal_dns_registrar
title: SEAL DNS & Registrar self-check
